reasoning: Al Rajhi Bank is the last uninitiated ticker in our coverage universe and represents our sole exposure to Saudi Arabia and Islamic banking — a structurally differentiated model at the heart of Vision 2030's financial transformation. At $96.50 with modest positive momentum (+0.5% today) amid broader market weakness, this is an opportune moment to establish our foundational view on the world's largest Islamic bank by market cap.
title: Al Rajhi Bank: The Shariah-Compliant Giant Riding Saudi Arabia's Transformation
angle: Consensus views RJHI as a defensive GCC play; Liria sees an underappreciated growth compounder benefiting from three secular tailwinds — Saudi mortgage penetration expanding from 5% to 30%+, Vision 2030 infrastructure spending requiring trillions in project finance, and demographic momentum as 70% of Saudis are under 35 and increasingly banked. The Shariah-compliant model isn't a constraint but a moat in a region where Islamic finance preference is rising.
